name: num_colors
title: Number of colors the terminal supports

origin.description: How many colors crayon should bake. crayon.colors wins when it is set.
origin.details: If crayon.colors is set, that integer is returned even when crayon.enabled is unset. Otherwise this is num_ansi_colors().

translation.description: How many colors crayon should bake. crayon.colors wins when it is set.
translation.details: Set crayon.colors through options(). When it is missing, the result is num_ansi_colors().
